data.text:
T.Paul Pandian vs The Designated Officer on 6 February, 2024 
Author: V.Bhavani Subbaroyan
Bench: V.Bhavani Subbaroyan
 W.P.(M
 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court
 Dated : 06.02.2024
 Coram
 The Hon'Ble Mrs Justice V.Bhavani Subbaroyan
 W.P.(MD)No.31335 of 2023
 and
 W.M.P(MD)Nos.26888 & 26889 of 2023
 T.Paul Pandian ... Petitioner
 Vs.
 1.The Designated Officer,
 Tamilnadu Food Safety Wing,
 Kanyakumari District.
 2.The Food Safety Officer,
 Agasteeswaram Block,
 Kanyakumari District. ...  Respondents  Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India,
 Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, calling for the records on the first respon  pertaining to its impugned proceedings in Na.Ka.No.2524/A2/2023 dated 20.12.
 and to quash the same and consequently direct the respondents to de-seal the  premises at Door No.16/73 A2, Ottayalvilai, Agasteeswaram Block, Kanyakumari  District so as to enable the petitioner to continuing his business.
 For Petitioner : Mr.SC.Herold Singh  For R1 & R2 : Mr.D.Gandhiraj  Special Government Pleader  *****
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  1/3 T.Paul Pandian vs The Designated Officer on 6 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165133307/
1  W.P.(M  ORDER The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the writ petition and he has also made an endorsement to that effect. 
2. In view of the endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed. 
 Index :Yes  Internet :Yes 06.02.2024  am  To 1.The Designated Officer, Tamilnadu Food Safety Wing, Kanyakumari District.
2.The Food Safety Officer, Agasteeswaram Block, Kanyakumari District.
